class.name: costmap_plugin::SlopeCostMap
class.description: Terrain slope cost map. Computes traversability costs from elevation data using centered finite differences.

class.name: costmap_plugin::RoughnessCostMap
class.description: Terrain roughness cost map. Penalizes uneven terrain based on local elevation variance in a configurable neighborhood.

class.name: costmap_plugin::ShadowCostMap
class.description: Light/shadow cost map. Uses ray marching on the elevation map to detect cells in shadow from a configurable sun direction. Relevant for lunar navigation where shadow affects temperature, solar power, and sensor visibility.
